Compact Muon Solenoid.fact: The first test which ran in September 2008 was expected to operate at a lower collision energy of 10 TeV but this was prevented by the 19 September 2008 shutdown.

Compact Muon Solenoid.question: The pixel detector was upgraded as a part of the CMS phase-1 upgrade in _____, which added an additional layer to both the barrel and endcap, and shifted the innermost layer 1.5 cm closer to the beaml
Compact Muon Solenoid.fact: The pixel detector was upgraded as a part of the CMS phase-1 upgrade in 2017, which added an additional layer to both the barrel and endcap, and shifted the innermost layer 1.5 cm closer to the beamline.
